meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: Claude 会调试 LazyCodex/Codex 的 bug，在临时工作区复现、写回归测试、做最小修复并验证，然后按归属交付：LazyCodex 自家缺陷产出带补丁的 issue；openai/codex 上游缺陷则从 fork 开 PR。
howto.when: 当用户要求修复 bug、为 bug 开 PR，或调试并提交 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修一下 LazyCodex 的 bug，并提交修复。
say.note: Claude 会按流程产出带补丁的 issue。

say.text: 这个 openai/codex 的缺陷需要修复，帮我开个 PR。
say.note: Claude 会从 fork 创建 PR。

say.text: 调试并提交一个 Codex 相关的 bug 修复。

howto.what_en: Claude debug a LazyCodex/Codex bug in a temp workspace, reproduce, add a regression test, fix minimally, verify, then deliver: verified-fix issue for LazyCodex-owned code, fork PR for openai/codex.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to fix a bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug and submit the fix.
say_en.note: Claude will create a verified-fix issue.

say_en.text: Open a PR for this openai/codex defect.
say_en.note: Claude will fork and open a PR.

say_en.text: Debug and PR this Codex-related bug.
